## Changes

Describe the behavior and compatibility impact.

## Release

- Release type: patch / minor / major
- Rationale:
- Previous version → next version:
- [ ] All three manifests and README versions agree.
- [ ] Every change is recorded with its date in the new changelog entry.
- [ ] Breaking changes include migration notes.
- [ ] Release validation and relevant tests pass against the latest main.

## Verification

Record commands run, outcomes and unverified behavior.
